verdict.rationale: Figma Make documents version history and a code-diff Review panel for the generated app, but these cover the app's code, not automations. The closest automation-like feature, reusable packaged workflow instructions, has no documented versioning, review, or rollback. App-level versioning is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
